notes: Timing and PMU sessions are distinct; counter-session latency is not normal TPOT.
MemoryAccess fields are preserved as CANN GM/main-memory counters, not assumed equal to physical HBM. System HBM counters are collected separately.
MAC/Vector ratios are instruction cycle occupancy, not achieved peak FLOPS. CPU waits include NPU execution and must not be added twice.
PCIe throughput sample fields are zero in these short decode windows; do not interpret zero as absence of traffic. PCIe latency counters have different units and are not bandwidth.
HBM system totals sum four channels, whereas exported hbm.csv Average is a channel average. Group kernel-duration sums are not an additive closed budget because concurrent tasks can overlap.
All direct Memory-group L2 read/write bandwidth fields were zero. L2 hit/miss request counts and MemoryAccess logical volumes are reported separately; no physical L2 byte rate is inferred.

traffic_units.system_hbm: Exporter MB/s, summed over four channels; MB=1e6 bytes, GB=1e9 bytes.
traffic_units.memory_access: CANN logical GM request volume, KB interpreted as 1024 bytes; GiB=2**30 bytes. Not physical HBM traffic.
traffic_units.l2: Raw hit/miss-allocate request counts. Direct l2_read/write_bw fields returned zero and are unavailable for bandwidth attribution.
traffic_units.pcie: Throughput MB/s; nonpost_latency us. Zero throughput samples cannot resolve the small messages.
